title: Canonical integral scalar quotient tower and strict Roos functors
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime and let $E,L$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$ with a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-embedding $\iota:E\to L$, valuation rings and fixed uniformizers [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $Y$ be a scheme with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. Put $A_{H,n+1}=\mathcal O_H/\varpi_H^{n+1}$ and $R_H=\varprojlim_{n\ge0}(A_{H,n+1})_Y$ for $H=E,L$, with their actual quotient projections [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. The valuation-ring inclusion induces $j_n:A_{E,n+1}\to A_{L,n+1}$; define $\rho_n:R_E\to(A_{L,n+1})_Y$ as the source projection followed by $(j_n)_Y$. For an unbounded complex $P$ of $R_E$-module sheaves, define $B_n(P)=\operatorname{Res}_{R_L\to(A_{L,n+1})_Y}((A_{L,n+1})_Y\otimes_{R_E,\rho_n}P)$ termwise by sheafified tensor and restriction of scalars [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] and [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars], using the ordinary coefficient-change functor of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. Define the sheafified pure-tensor section $s\otimes x$ through the sheafification unit and the prescribed identification with that ordinary functor. Define $\tau_n:B_{n+1}\to B_n$ to be the unique natural chain map sending every such section $s\otimes x$ to $\operatorname{red}(s)\otimes x$. Define the strict functor $T:P\mapsto(B_n(P),\tau_n)_{n\ge0}$ with its termwise tensor action on all chain maps. Define $C(P)=\operatorname{Roos}(T(P))$, with the signed mapping cocone and diagonal maps of [def-sf-strict-roos-functor]. Finally define $C_{\mathrm{good}}$ as inclusion of flat-term K-flat complexes [def-a1-flat-term-kflat-complex], followed by $C$ and complex localization $Q$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The scheme and coefficient universes are independent. These are concrete functors, not assertions of quasi-isomorphism preservation or localization descent.
